; hrtng plugin use this file to convert numeric constants to IDA enums. 
; Here are some functions and structures names together with defines and enums they may use.
; WARNING: The file is autogenerated from old MSDN pages and may be incomplete and contain some wrong definitions
; 
; Used the following format:
; 1) 'FunctionName' or 'STRUCT' <space> 'StructName' in line begginning (no spaces or tabs before)
; 2) <space> [FuncArgumentNumber | StructFieldName] <space> [Type] : Where FuncArgumentNumber started from 1. 0 means return value. Type is 'enum' for exclusive values or 'bits' for values may be combined with bitwise OR
; 3) <space> <space> [LiteralName] <space> [Value]
;    .....
; 4) empty line
;
